content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Anchorage

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with five years of experience. Review PMI's full education and experience criteria to confirm you meet the baseline before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our synchronous classes fit working schedules across Alaska's oil & gas, healthcare, military, and government sectors, delivering all required contact hours through interactive online instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your PMP application to PMI along with proof of education, work experience, and course completion. Pay the PMI examination fee and await eligibility verification before scheduling your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials and practice tests to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson testing center and demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge across the PMP's ten domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, volunteering, or publishing. Submit your renewal application and fee to PMI before your credential expires to stay current in your local market.
